status_reason: The rigid loading path is collision-free and the localized compliant key is derived from the bound holder void, but the actual pre-wired antenna profile and physical retention/rattle/print fit remain unmeasured.
authority: Reviewed machine contract for the pillar-only base and bottom-loaded, already-wired RX2 reference-antenna adapter. Values describe the CAD candidate, not production antenna measurements.
derived_assertions: base_sidewall_h is zero and the lower perimeter is absent
the base contains four PCB supports and four geometrically independent case posts
each case post clears its nearest PCB corner by at least 1.00 mm
body_axis_z equals body_d/2 plus the 0.20 mm closed-lid floor gap
rail_gap equals body_d plus twice body_radial_clearance
the localized compliant key gap, open mouth, and entry blend equal the bound holder's D9.75/D11.75/R1 compliant void evidence
the localized key overlaps the D10 candidate envelope by 0.125 mm radially and therefore remains a physical-fit candidate, not rigid clearance
the fit coupon exposes actual channel gaps 9.50, 9.75, 10.00, and 10.25 mm
south U-arch diameter equals body_d plus twice body_radial_clearance and therefore clears the complete lower antenna radius
reference mesh bounds and volumes match fresh SCAD selector exports
all access margins in the receipt are recomputed from these facts and the bound enclosure interfaces
excluded_claims: This contract does not convert the supplied flexible-holder voids into an authoritative antenna drawing.
It does not prove physical lock, rattle resistance, cable termination clearance, printer fit, PCB seating, or PRINT_VERIFIED status.
The four-millimeter compliant-key length is a candidate and requires coupon/assembly testing.
